description: This Java class 'DriverFactory' is responsible for creating, managing, and quitting Selenium WebDriver instances. It supports Chrome and Firefox browsers, provides thread-safe WebDriver management for parallel test execution, handles browser profile directories to avoid conflicts, and includes retry logic for robust driver initialization.

classes.name: DriverFactory
classes.description: A utility class providing thread-safe creation, retrieval, and cleanup of Selenium WebDriver instances for Chrome and Firefox browsers. Supports headless and headed modes with custom profile directories and retry mechanisms.

methods.name: initDriver
methods.description: Initializes a WebDriver based on configuration, with retries; sets timeouts and window size; stores in ThreadLocal.

methods.name: getDriver
methods.description: Retrieves the WebDriver instance for the current thread, throws exception if not initialized.

methods.name: quitDriver
methods.description: Quits the WebDriver for the current thread and cleans ThreadLocal storage.

methods.name: createDriver
methods.description: Dispatches WebDriver creation based on browser type ('chrome' or 'firefox').

methods.name: createChromeDriver
methods.description: Creates a Chrome WebDriver with specific options for CI stability and parallel execution safety.

methods.name: createFirefoxDriver
methods.description: Creates a Firefox WebDriver with options supportive of headless mode and parallel execution safety.

methods.name: parseIntSafe
methods.description: Safely parses a string to an integer, defaults to 2 if parsing fails.
